Name: Jeiel, Son of Mattaniah
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, was an ancestor of Jahaziel the Levite upon whom the Spirit came before Jehoshaphat's army.
KeyStory: Jeiel stands in Jahaziel's line: son of Mattaniah, father of Benaiah.
RelatedPeople: Jahaziel, Son of Zechariah; Mattaniah, Ancestor of Jahaziel
LifeLesson: Generations of worship prepared the ground for a word in a crisis.
